scope: Current 244-record US research catalog. Category counts overlap where a sauna kit also belongs to a placement and heat-type segment. Counts describe distinct product models, never size or electrical variants.
data_complete_definition: Product type, heat type, energy source, placement, form, seated capacity, exterior dimensions and materials are documented, and one electrical requirement documents voltage, rated power and rated current together.

categories.label: Indoor infrared cabins
gaps: Several Sunlighten records do not yet contain normalized electrical requirements.
Shipping dimensions and minimum clearances are not published for every model.

categories.label: Outdoor infrared cabins
gaps: The Sun Home Luminar 2 record still lacks a documented rated-power value.
Outdoor installation clearances and site requirements remain model-specific checks.

categories.label: Indoor traditional saunas
gaps: The Sun Home Nova 3 record does not yet contain normalized exterior dimensions or electrical requirements.
Included heater and control packages must remain configuration-specific.

categories.label: Outdoor traditional saunas
gaps: Several SaunaLife and Thermory kits are cabin structures without a documented included electrical package.
Foundation, roof, weather exposure and heater selection cannot be inferred from exterior dimensions alone.

categories.label: Sauna kits
gaps: Kit-only records need a clear distinction between the structure and any separately selected heater or controls.
Some models still rely on product-range context in addition to an exact model page.

categories.label: Sauna heaters
gaps: The heater segment needs exact model identities, compatible room-volume ranges and model-specific electrical documentation.

categories.label: Accessories and portable products
gaps: Accessories should not be presented as sauna cabins or counted toward cabin coverage.
Portable products need their own comparison intent and specification criteria before search publication.

next_priorities: Write and review unique decision copy for the ten technically qualified first-wave products.
Normalize model-level electrical packages for the strongest traditional outdoor candidates before expanding the launch wave.
Keep heater, accessory and portable pages out of search until their taxonomy and user intent have dedicated editorial coverage.
Do not enable US indexing from catalog count alone.
